text:
I fixed six bugs in `catalog/`, but I couldn't run `python3 -m unittest` because I have no shell tool here. I checked each fix by reading it against the tests, so please run the suite to confirm it passes.

- **`search.py`:** it imported `normalize` from `catalog.nonexistent`. It now imports from `catalog.text`.
- **`members.py`:** `MAX_BORROWED` was 3, but the policy comment and the tests say 5. It is now 5.
- **`fees.py`:** the late fee added days and the daily rate (`days_late + DAILY_FEE`) instead of multiplying them. It now uses `*`.
- **`factory.py`:** `sample_books()` was missing `Emma`. I added `Book("Emma", "Austen", 1815, 1)`. The author, year and copies come from my own choice; the tests only check the title.
- **`inventory.py`:** `recent(n)` returned `n + 1` events because of an off-by-one slice. It now returns the last `n`, or an empty list when `n` is 0 or less.
- **`books.py`:** `parse_book` left `year` as a string. It now converts it to an `int`.
